# Cleanup composition inputs

These are retained proof-only postambles, contracts, source-region topology and
private-cell layouts from the checked Metapad cleanup entry/loop/tail products
recorded in `docs/current-goal.md` (v107/v113). They contain no application body.
The production composition phase reads these facts from the current validated
regional products and source graph; this fixture is not a proof receipt.

Tests check assertion guards, complete regional ownership, coarse successors,
loop ranking and saved-word preservation. Changes to a scope, successor or loop
write frame must reject even when property descriptions remain unchanged.
Actual caller, runtime and complete state/trace qualification remain separate.

Service-model excerpts retain the exact entry, loop and tail proof callbacks,
including the entry no-public-write-before-call premise. Observation tests bind
these checked-model rules and reject hidden effects or weakened event recorders.
They are fixture data, not independently qualified service implementations.
